name: caduceus-dashboard
description: Your Hermes agents, in your pocket. A mobile-first dashboard to chat with your agents, approve what they ask, review finished work and run their schedules. Self-hosted on your Mac, reached privately over Tailscale. Unofficial companion to Hermes Agent.
author: Sunny Phung (https://github.com/SunnySydeUp)

scripts.dev: npm run build -w web && npm run start -w server
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w web && playwright test
scripts.perf: npm run build -w web && tsx server/scripts/perf.ts
